vintage: DVF 2024–2025 / DREES APL 2024 / RPLS 2023 / ADEME DPE

lenses.name: House prices
lenses.description: Transaction-count-weighted mean of commune median house sale prices per m², DVF sales in 2024–2025. DVF excludes Alsace-Moselle and Mayotte.

lenses.name: Apartment prices
lenses.description: Transaction-count-weighted mean of commune median apartment sale prices per m², DVF sales in 2024–2025. Sparse rural coverage reflects few apartment sales.

lenses.name: Housing-market liquidity
lenses.description: House and apartment sale records in DVF 2024–2025 per 10,000 residents. This measures transaction volume over roughly two years, not turnover among all dwellings; DVF excludes Alsace-Moselle and Mayotte.

lenses.name: Apartment sale share
lenses.description: Apartment sales as a share of all house and apartment sale records in DVF 2024–2025. This reflects the transacted stock rather than the full dwelling stock and is sparse where there are few sales.

lenses.name: Energy-poor housing
lenses.description: Share of post-July-2021 existing-home DPE records rated F or G, population-weighted within map hexes. DPEs are triggered mainly by sales, rentals and works, so they are a biased sample rather than a census of all housing.

lenses.name: Efficient housing
lenses.description: Share of post-July-2021 existing-home DPE records rated A or B, population-weighted within map hexes. DPEs are triggered mainly by sales, rentals and works, so they are a biased sample rather than a census of all housing.

lenses.name: Social housing
lenses.description: Population-weighted commune share of primary residences that are social housing in the 2023 RPLS. The published indicator excludes habitat spécifique and certain SEM stock and is not directly comparable with the legal SRU article-55 rate.

lenses.name: GP access
lenses.description: General-practitioner accessibility: accessible consultations, visits and teleconsultations per standardised resident per year. Commune APL values are population-weighted within each map hex; DREES coverage excludes Mayotte.

lenses.name: Nurse access
lenses.description: Nurse accessibility in full-time equivalents per 100,000 standardised residents. Commune APL values are population-weighted within each map hex; DREES coverage excludes Mayotte.

lenses.name: Dentist access
lenses.description: Dentist accessibility in full-time equivalents per 100,000 standardised residents. Commune APL values are population-weighted within each map hex; DREES coverage excludes Mayotte.

lenses.name: Midwife access
lenses.description: Midwife accessibility in full-time equivalents per 100,000 standardised residents. Commune APL values are population-weighted within each map hex; DREES coverage excludes Mayotte.
